title: A landing whose own ticket another landing removed counts every later ticket as ahead and is starved behind later askers until its wait bound
goal: landing_tickets_ahead lists no ticket once the ticket of the asking landing is missing from the queue, and the landing takes its place in the queue again

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
qdir = bl_close.landing_queue_dir(bl_close.landing_lock_path(t))
qdir.mkdir()
child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(60)"])
try:
    time.sleep(1)
    now = time.time_ns()
    later = "%020d-%d" % (now + 5 * 10 ** 9, child.pid)
    (qdir / later).write_text("pid=%d\nclone=%s\nstarted=x\nitem=ST-bbbbbbbb\n" % (child.pid, t))
    mine = "%020d-%d" % (now, os.getpid())
    ahead = [a[0] for a in bl_close.landing_tickets_ahead(qdir, mine)]
    print("tickets this landing waits for, all asked after it:", ahead)
    sys.exit(0 if not ahead else 1)
finally:
    child.kill()

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
qdir = bl_close.landing_queue_dir(bl_close.landing_lock_path(t))
older = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(60)"])
time.sleep(1)
qdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(qdir / ("%020d-%d" % (time.time_ns(), older.pid))).write_text("pid=%d\nclone=%s\nstarted=x\nitem=ST-bbbbbbbb\n" % (older.pid, t))
prog = "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_close\nwith bl_close.landing_lock(sys.argv[1], 'ST-aaaaaaaa', poll=0.1):\n    pass\n"
me = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", prog, t], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
code = 1
try:
    def mine():
        return [f for f in os.listdir(qdir) if f.endswith("-%d" % me.pid)]
    for _ in range(100):
        if mine():
            break
        time.sleep(0.1)
    seen = mine()
    for f in seen:
        os.unlink(qdir / f)
    time.sleep(2)
    again = mine()
    print("ticket of the waiting landing after another landing removed it:", again)
    code = 0 if (seen and again) else 1
    print('ticket seen before removal:', bool(seen))
finally:
    me.kill()
    older.kill()
sys.exit(code)

gates.question: Where does a landing whose ticket another landing removed take its place again?
options: at the back of the queue, with a new ticket named by the time it asks again
at its old place, by remaking the ticket under its first name
gates.recommendation: at the back of the queue, with a new ticket named by the time it asks again
gates.reason: a remade old name could sit before a ticket that took the lock meanwhile and would break the order the others saw
gates.answer: at the back of the queue, with a new ticket named by the time it asks again
